verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes an official GitHub repo (snowflakedb/snowflake-rest-api-specs) with OpenAPI-compliant specification files and importable Postman collections, and its REST API docs say integrations are built from those OpenAPI specs. The probe's 404s at guessed docs-domain paths show only that the spec isn't at a conventional URL; they don't contradict the published specs. Missing for 10: discoverable spec at a well-known URL, evidence that the specs also cover the SQL API and Cortex APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
